title: RGS 64B seed provenance for the Ellis curved refinement

A13.use: independent Q6 edge/coframe provenance and audit

reconstruction.coordinate_order: 8 O_h orbits; each orbit uses sign order product((-1,+1), repeat=3)
reconstruction.q6_edge_order: for g=0..63 and axes 0..5, add (g,g xor 2^axis,axis) when that bit of g is zero
reconstruction.q6_unit_coframe: raw coframe divided by its Euclidean R4 norm

geometry.status: geometric benchmark only; not a full RGS-EMS field-equation solution

non_identifications: The Q6 2-skeleton is not treated as a tetrahedral mesh.
The archived Q6 link coframe is not silently relabelled as the new tetrahedral coframe.
The flat-torus Mosco theorem is not transferred to this curved family.
No physical field-equation solution is claimed.
